verdict.rationale: Stable's registered agent product explicitly targets government/legal mail (service of process, state correspondence, IRS) and offers automated routing, AI summaries, tagging, and notifications to surface important mail quickly, plus automated filing guidance. However, there's no explicit evidence of dedicated 'compliance deadline' flagging/prioritization logic (e.g., deadline extraction, due-date alerts, escalation for unread critical mail) distinct from general auto-routing/keyword rules. Missing for 10: explicit deadline-detection/extraction features, prioritization-by-urgency mechanics, escalation workflows for unread compliance mail, and independent/hands-on confirmation that these routing rules reliably catch IRS/service-of-process mail.
